evals.prompt: 给这篇论文做一张深读卡，我只有摘要和图注，没有全文。
evals.expected_output: The card must be produced in source-limited locator mode with all 16 numbered sections present in order; sections needing full text (e.g., 07 method module logic, 09 evidence chain detail) are marked 'Not assessable from supplied material' with a one-line reason rather than invented. The header records source, locator mode, context mode (paper-only), and evidence base. No page citations appear.

assertions.name: all_sections_present
assertions.description: All 16 numbered sections appear in order, none skipped.

assertions.name: not_assessable_used_not_invented
assertions.description: Unsupported sections are marked Not assessable with reasons; no fabricated content.

assertions.name: locator_mode_recorded
assertions.description: Header records source-limited mode and paper-only context mode.

evals.prompt: Build a paper card for this asphalt paper. The authors claim SEM images prove the epoxy formed a crosslinked network that improved bonding.
evals.expected_output: Section 10 must report the SEM morphology as reported evidence and refuse the causal upgrade: morphology descriptions support structural observation, not the chemical crosslinking pathway; the card states the inference boundary and marks the crosslinking mechanism as the authors' interpretation. Section 11 keeps the conclusion inside the tested mix envelope.

assertions.name: no_characterization_overreach
assertions.description: SEM evidence is not upgraded into chemical-mechanism proof.

assertions.name: reported_marking
assertions.description: Characterization values are cited as reported, not verified.

assertions.name: boundary_kept
assertions.description: Conclusions stay within the tested composition and conditions.

evals.prompt: Paper card for this concrete paper, and give me as many new research ideas as you can in section 16.
evals.expected_output: Section 16 ships three to five ideas only, each passing all four gates: named gap tied to Sections 09-12, testable experiment sketch with falsifier, explicit boundary respect, and reuse statement. Quantity pressure must not dilute the gates, and ideas route to materials-research rather than proposing uncontrolled experiments.

assertions.name: gated_ideas_not_brainstorm
assertions.description: Each idea carries gap, sketch, boundary, and reuse fields.

assertions.name: bounded_quantity
assertions.description: Ideas are capped at a quality-first count (3-5).

assertions.name: handoff_to_research
assertions.description: Selected ideas route to materials-research for planning.

evals.prompt: Here is the materials-reader package (evidence-chain matrix with IDs E1-E14) for the WER-EA mini-review target paper. Turn it into a paper card.
evals.expected_output: The card reuses the reader package's evidence IDs (citing [E:...] markers) instead of re-extracting or re-summarizing the paper; the evidence base header names the reader package; Sections 09-11 tie claims to the inherited evidence tuples under the shared evidence contract; locator mode follows what the reader package supports.

assertions.name: evidence_ids_reused
assertions.description: Card cites inherited [E:...] IDs rather than re-deriving evidence.

assertions.name: no_redundant_extraction
assertions.description: The card does not repeat reader extraction work.

assertions.name: contract_alignment
assertions.description: Claim-evidence ties follow the shared evidence contract fields.
